name: Symbol Spin
description: Auto-rotate your active TradingView chart through every symbol in your watchlist on a timer. Features: custom interval (1s–1h, presets 5/10/30/60s), hands-free chart switching without reloading the page, layout preservation (timeframe, indicators and drawings stay intact), auto-detect watchlist from the TradingView DOM, manual ticker list override, pause / resume / skip-next controls, keyboard-driven symbol change so the page never reloads, zero network calls, zero telemetry. Personal build.
